descriptions.w3d_runtime_reset_time: Sets core time and records the new runtime total.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_pause_retain: Increments the runtime pause count and pauses the core.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_pause_release: Decrements the pause count and resumes the core when it reaches zero.
descriptions.w3d_runtime_is_paused: Reports a local pause or the global context pause value.
descriptions.w3d_history_tick: Records elapsed clock ticks for the next history frame.
descriptions.w3d_history_construct: Initializes and resets an empty timing history.
descriptions.w3d_text_owner_destroy: Releases text-owner interfaces, strings and backing storage.
descriptions.w3d_text_owner_make_handle: Retains the text-owner service and initializes handle flags.
